answer: The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in cedar, expire in delta, and ferrous lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 12 aliases therefore needs 157 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3487 identities would post 2867 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
